Hey developer friends, welcome to Issue 87 of the weekly developer tooling newsletter. This week we have 5 links to share.

First up is a new Rust linter that catches bugs before they reach production. Next is a Git GUI for branching, merging, and reviewing commits. Last is a tracing tool for finding performance bottlenecks.

Whether you're a seasoned pro or just getting started, there should be something here for you. Grab a coffee and settle in.

9,400 people subscribe to this newsletter. Thanks for reading.
